name: Minoru Akimura
source: He is usually your competition in the Public Relations Department at Evermore Consulting, but now you’ll have to work together?! He can typically be found breaking hearts around the office; dumping girls after a one night stand seems like his MO. Still, you can see something more in his eyes.. There’s a deep disdain for women, or is it a painful memory?
